records.literal_gloss: A psalm for thanksgiving. Shout to YHWH, all the earth.

en.L: A psalm for thanksgiving. \q Shout for joy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth.
en.B: A psalm for giving thanks. \q Raise a glad shout to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth!
en.R: A song for giving thanks. \q Everyone on earth, shout to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with joy!

fr.L: Un psaume pour l’action de grâce. \q Acclamez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, toute la terre.
fr.B: Un psaume pour rendre grâce. \q Poussez des cris de joie pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, terre entière !
fr.R: Un chant pour dire merci. \q Vous tous qui êtes sur la terre, criez de joie pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Zaburi ya shukrani. \q Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kelele za furaha, dunia yote.
sw.B: Zaburi ya kutoa shukrani. \q Mshangilieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dunia yote!
sw.R: Wimbo wa kutoa shukrani. \q Kila mtu duniani, mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kelele za furaha!

es.L: Salmo para la acción de gracias. \q {{plural_you:Aclamen|Aclamad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, toda la tierra.
es.B: Salmo para dar gracias. \q ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} un grito de gozo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, toda la tierra!
es.R: Canto para dar gracias. \q ¡Todos los que viven en la tierra, {{plural_you:griten|gritad}} de alegría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên để cảm tạ. \q Hãy reo hò cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi cả trái đất.
vi.B: Thi thiên để dâng lời cảm tạ. \q Hỡi cả trái đất, hãy cất tiếng reo mừng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Bài ca để cảm tạ. \q Hỡi mọi người trên đất, hãy reo hò vui mừng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!

ko.L: 감사의 시. \q 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기뻐 외쳐라.
ko.B: 감사드리는 시. \q 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 즐거이 외쳐라!
ko.R: 감사드리는 노래. \q 땅 위의 모든 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기쁘게 외쳐라!

pt.L: Salmo para ação de graças. \q Gritem de alegria {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra.
pt.B: Salmo para dar graças. \q Ergam um grito alegre {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra!
pt.R: Uma canção para agradecer. \q Todos na terra, gritem de alegria para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!

am.L: የምስጋና መዝሙር። \q ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ ጩኹ።
am.B: የምስጋና መዝሙር። \q ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የደስታ ጩኸት አሰሙ!
am.R: ለምስጋና የሚዘመር መዝሙር። \q በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ ጩኹ!

hi.L: धन्यवाद का भजन। \q हे सारी पृथ्वी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का जयजयकार करो।
hi.B: धन्यवाद देने के लिए भजन। \q हे सारी पृथ्वी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आनंद से जयजयकार करो!
hi.R: धन्यवाद देने के लिए गीत। \q पृथ्वी के सब लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आनंद से जयजयकार करो!

ru.L: Псалом для благодарения. \q Радостно кричите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вся земля.
ru.B: Псалом, чтобы благодарить. \q Поднимите радостный клич {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вся земля!
ru.R: Песнь благодарения. \q Все люди на земле, радостно кричите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}!

ja.L: 感謝の賛歌。 \q 全地よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜び叫べ。
ja.B: 感謝をささげるための賛歌。 \q 全地よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に向かって喜びの声を上げよ！
ja.R: 感謝をささげるための歌。 \q 地上のすべての人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜びの声を上げよ！

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: for thanksgiving: for giving thanks
decisions.reason: The word (todah) is thanks, and also the thank offering (Leviticus 7:12). The psalm may have been sung when such an offering was brought; verse 4 has worshipers entering the temple gates with thanks.

decisions.choice: shout: the cry that greets a king
decisions.reason: The same verb (heria') as 98:4 and 95:1: the glad shout raised for the King.

decisions.choice: "감사의 시" (L), "감사드리는 시" (B), "감사드리는 노래" (R)
decisions.reason: The title may name a song of thanks or one sung with a thank offering (meaning decision m2); Korean says thanks and leaves the offering unnamed, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Gritem de alegria (L); Ergam um grito alegre (B); gritem de alegria (R)
decisions.reason: The same verb as 98:4 and 95:1 (m3), so each level keeps the wording used there for the shout that greets the King. The psalm was drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, as the familiar Portuguese versions of it are not to be followed.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: the title as "የምስጋና መዝሙር" (Literal, Balanced), "ለምስጋና የሚዘመር መዝሙር" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word (todah) is thanks and also the thank offering (meaning decision). Amharic "ምስጋና" is thanks; the offering is only a possibility, so the title does not name it. "Shout" (heriʿa) is "በደስታ ጩኹ" (Literal, Readable), "የደስታ ጩኸት አሰሙ" (Balanced), as in 98:4.

decisions.choice: "धन्यवाद का भजन" (L), "धन्यवाद देने के लिए भजन/गीत" (B, R); the shout as 98:4
decisions.reason: The title names the psalm for giving thanks (todah, meaning m2), with mizmor as "भजन" (L, B) and "गीत" (R), as the poetry note has it. The shout that greets the King (meaning m3) keeps the wording of 98:4 at each level. This familiar psalm is drafted from the Hebrew and its gloss.

decisions.choice: "Псалом" (L, B), "Песнь" (R); the shout as Psalm 98:4
decisions.reason: The title follows the poetry note's table for mizmor; "Shout to the LORD, all the earth" is the Hebrew of Psalm 98:4a, so each level keeps that wording.

decisions.choice: mizmor letodah "感謝の賛歌" (L), "感謝をささげるための賛歌" (B), "…歌" (R); hari'u "喜び叫べ" (L), "喜びの声を上げよ" (B, R), as 98:4
decisions.reason: For thanksgiving is for giving thanks (m2, uncertain); the shout greets a king (m3), with the words of 98:4. Psalm 100 is drafted afresh, not after a familiar Japanese wording; the call to the earth is 〜せよ at every level.

source.text: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Serve YHWH with gladness; come before him with a joyful cry.

en.L: Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with gladness; \q come before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with joyful singing.
en.B: Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and be glad doing it; \q come before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with ringing cries of joy.
en.R: Be happy as you serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} singing for joy!

fr.L: Servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec allégresse ; \q venez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec des chants de joie.
fr.B: Servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et soyez heureux de le faire ; \q présentez-vous devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec des cris de joie éclatants.
fr.R: Soyez heureux de servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! \q Approchez-vous de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} en chantant de joie !

sw.L: Mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa furaha; \q njooni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa nyimbo za shangwe.
sw.B: Mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huku mkifurahi; \q njooni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa vigelegele vya furaha.
sw.R: Furahini mnapomtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Njooni {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} mkiimba kwa furaha!

es.L: {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con gozo; \q {{plural_you:lleguen|llegad}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con cantos de júbilo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}} con alegría; \q {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con gritos de júbilo.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} felices mientras {{plural_you:sirven|servís}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q ¡{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cantando de alegría!

vi.L: Hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với niềm vui; \q hãy đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tiếng hát reo mừng.
vi.B: Hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và vui mừng khi làm việc ấy; \q hãy đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tiếng reo vui vang dội.
vi.R: Hãy vui vẻ khi phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và hát lên vui mừng!

ko.L: 기쁨으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라. \q 기뻐 노래하며 그분 앞에 나아가거라.
ko.B: 기쁜 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라. \q 환호성을 올리며 그분 앞에 나아가거라.
ko.R: 기쁘게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라! \q 즐겁게 노래하며 그분께 나아가거라!

pt.L: Sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} com contentamento; \q venham à presença {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com cantos de júbilo.
pt.B: Sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e façam isso com prazer; \q cheguem diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com gritos alegres e sonoros.
pt.R: Sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} felizes! \q Venham até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cantando de alegria!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} በደስታ አገልግሉ፤ \q በእልልታ ወደ ፊቱ ኑ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} በደስታ አገልግሉ፤ \q በደስታ ዝማሬ ወደ ፊቱ ቅረቡ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ደስ እያላችሁ አገልግሉ! \q በደስታ እየዘመራችሁ ወደ እርሱ ኑ!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सेवा आनंद के साथ करो; \q आनंद के गीत गाते हुए उनके सामने आओ।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सेवा करो और उसमें मगन रहो; \q आनंद की ऊँची पुकार के साथ उनके सामने आओ।
hi.R: ख़ुशी-ख़ुशी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सेवा करो! \q आनंद से गाते हुए उनके पास आओ!

ru.L: Служите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} в веселье; \q предстаньте перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} с радостным пением.
ru.B: Служите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} и радуйтесь этому; \q придите к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} со звонкими возгласами радости.
ru.R: Служите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} с радостью! \q Приходите к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}, распевая от радости!

ja.L: 喜びをもって{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕えよ。 \q 喜び歌いつつ、その前に進み出よ。
ja.B: 喜んで、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕えよ。 \q 喜びの声を響かせて、その方の前に進み出よ。
ja.R: 喜んで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に仕えよ！ \q 喜びの歌を歌いながら、その方の前に出よ！

decisions.choice: serve: work for and worship
decisions.reason: The verb ('avad) is the work a servant does for a master or subjects for a king, and also worship (Exodus 3:12). All the earth is called to serve the LORD as King.

decisions.choice: a joyful cry: a ringing shout or song
decisions.reason: The word (renanah) is a loud cry of joy.

decisions.choice: "vigelegele vya furaha" for the ringing cries of joy at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a loud, ringing cry of joy; "vigelegele" are the high ululating cries of celebration that Swahili speakers know, which fits the picture closely.

decisions.choice: "सेवा करो" at every level
decisions.reason: The verb is the work a servant does for a master or subjects for a king, which here includes worship (meaning m1). Hindi "सेवा" carries both senses, as the English "serve" does, so it is kept at every level rather than narrowed to "आराधना".

decisions.choice: 'ivdu "仕えよ"; birnanah "喜び歌いつつ" (L), "喜びの声を響かせて" (B), "喜びの歌を歌いながら" (R)
decisions.reason: To serve is to work for and worship (m1); the joyful cry is a ringing shout or song (m2).

source.text: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־עָ֭שָׂנוּ וְל֣וֹ אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Know that YHWH, he [is] God; he made us, and his [are] we, his people and [the] flock of his pasture.

en.L: Know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] God! \q It [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [who] made us, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} [are] we, \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and the flock of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} pasture.
en.B: Be sure of this: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is God! \q He is the one who made us, and we belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q We are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, the flock {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pastures.
en.R: You must understand that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is the true God. \q He made us, and we belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q We are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. We are like sheep, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cares for us like a shepherd.

fr.L: Sachez que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, [est] Dieu ! \q C’[est] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [qui] nous a faits, et à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [sommes-]nous, \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et le troupeau de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} pâturage.
fr.B: Soyez-en sûrs : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est Dieu ! \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui nous a faits, et nous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenons. \q Nous sommes {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, le troupeau qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait paître.
fr.R: Comprenez bien que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le vrai Dieu. \q Il nous a faits, et nous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenons. \q Nous sommes {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Nous sommes comme des brebis, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend soin de nous comme un berger.

sw.L: Jueni kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] Mungu! \q Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [aliyetuumba], nasi [tu] {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kondoo wa malisho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Hakikisheni jambo hili: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu! \q Yeye ndiye aliyetuumba, nasi ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Sisi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kundi analolichunga.
sw.R: Mnapaswa kuelewa kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu wa kweli. \q Yeye alituumba, nasi ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Sisi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Sisi ni kama kondoo, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anatutunza kama mchungaji.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Sepan|Sabed}} que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] Dios! \q Él [es quien] nos hizo, y {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}} [somos] nosotros, \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y el rebaño de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} prado.
es.B: {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} seguros de esto: ¡{{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Dios! \q Él es quien nos hizo, y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecemos. \q Somos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, el rebaño que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apacienta.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que entender que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el Dios verdadero. \q Él nos hizo, y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecemos. \q Somos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Somos como ovejas, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos cuida como un pastor.

vi.L: Hãy biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời! \q Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đã] dựng nên chúng ta, và chúng ta [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và bầy chiên của đồng cỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy biết chắc điều này: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời! \q Ngài là Đấng đã dựng nên chúng ta, và chúng ta thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chúng ta là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăn dắt.
vi.R: Hãy hiểu rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời thật. \q Ngài đã dựng nên chúng ta, và chúng ta thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chúng ta là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng ta như bầy chiên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc chúng ta như người chăn chiên.

ko.L: 너희는 알아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분이 하나님이시다! \q 그분께서 우리를 지으셨으니, 우리는 그분의 것, \q 그분의 백성이요 그분 목장의 양 떼이다.
ko.B: 이것을 분명히 알아라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나님이시다! \q 그분께서 우리를 지으셨고, 우리는 그분께 속해 있다. \q 우리는 그분의 백성이요, 그분께서 먹이시는 양 떼이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 참하나님이시라는 것을 깨달아라. \q 그분께서 우리를 만드셨고, 우리는 그분의 것이다. \q 우리는 그분의 백성이다. 우리는 양과 같고, 그분께서는 목자처럼 우리를 돌보신다.

pt.L: Saibam que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] Deus! \q [É] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [que] nos fez, e {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} [somos] nós, \q o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo e o rebanho do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} pasto.
pt.B: Tenham certeza disto: {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é Deus! \q É {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quem nos fez, e nós pertencemos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Somos o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, o rebanho que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} leva ao pasto.
pt.R: Entendam bem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é o Deus verdadeiro. \q Ele nos fez, e nós pertencemos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Somos o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. Somos como ovelhas, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cuida de nós como um pastor.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ እወቁ! \q የሠራን እርሱ [ነው]፤ እኛም የእርሱ [ነን]፤ \q ሕዝቡና የማሰማሪያው መንጋ [ነን]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላክ እንደ ሆነ በእርግጥ እወቁ! \q የሠራን እርሱ ነው፤ እኛም የእርሱ ነን። \q እኛ ሕዝቡ፣ እርሱ የሚያሰማራን መንጋ ነን።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እውነተኛ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ ልትረዱ ይገባል። \q እርሱ ሠራን፤ እኛም የእርሱ ነን። \q እኛ ሕዝቡ ነን። እንደ በጎች ነን፤ እርሱም እንደ እረኛ ይንከባከበናል።

hi.L: जान लो कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, वे ही परमेश्वर [हैं]! \q वे ही [हैं जिन्होंने] हमें बनाया, और हम उनके अपने [हैं], \q उनकी प्रजा, उनके चरागाह का झुंड।
hi.B: इस बात में निश्चिंत रहो: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} परमेश्वर हैं! \q उन्होंने ही हमें रचा है, और हम उनके हैं। \q हम उनकी प्रजा हैं, वह झुंड जिसे वे चराते हैं।
hi.R: तुम्हें समझ लेना चाहिए कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही सच्चे परमेश्वर हैं। \q उन्होंने हमें बनाया, और हम उनके हैं। \q हम उनकी प्रजा हैं। हम भेड़ों के समान हैं, और वे चरवाहे की तरह हमारी देखभाल करते हैं।

ru.L: Знайте, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} Бог! \q Это {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал нас, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} мы, \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народ и стадо {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} пастбища.
ru.B: Знайте точно: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Бог! \q Он — тот, кто создал нас, и мы принадлежим {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. \q Мы — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народ, стадо, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пасёт.
ru.R: Поймите, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — истинный Бог. \q Он создал нас, и мы принадлежим {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. \q Мы — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народ. Мы как овцы, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заботится о нас, как пастух.

ja.L: 知れ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ神であることを。 \q その方がわたしたちを造られた。わたしたちはその方のもの、 \q その方の民、その方の牧場の羊。
ja.B: このことを確かに知れ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ神である！ \q その方がわたしたちを造られ、わたしたちはその方のものである。 \q わたしたちはその方の民、その方が養われる群れ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ本当の神であることを、しっかりと知れ。 \q その方がわたしたちを造られた。わたしたちはその方のものだ。 \q わたしたちはその方の民。わたしたちは羊のようで、その方は羊飼いのように、わたしたちの世話をしてくださる。

decisions.choice: and we are his: the words as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes "and not (lo') we" and its notes say to read "and his (lo) we [are]"; the two sound alike. The written form gives "he made us, and not we ourselves", which the ancient Greek translation follows. The form to be read fits the next words, "his people and the flock of his pasture", and the words here follow it.

decisions.choice: know: acknowledge, be sure
decisions.reason: To know here is to recognize and confess (46:11), not only to have heard.

decisions.choice: the flock of his pasture: the people he shepherds
decisions.reason: As in 95:7 and 79:13, God's people are his flock and he is their shepherd.

decisions.choice: the true God
decisions.reason: Readable brings out the emphasis of "the LORD, he is God" (1 Kings 18:39).

decisions.choice: like sheep, and he cares for us like a shepherd
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture a comparison (m3).

decisions.choice: "우리는 그분의 것" (we are his)
alternatives: "우리가 우리 자신을 지은 것이 아니다" (not we ourselves)
decisions.reason: Korean follows the words as read in the Hebrew text (meaning decision m1); the written form, "and not we ourselves", is the reading other translations have followed.

decisions.choice: "the LORD, he is God" with "አምላክ"
decisions.reason: Beside the divine name, Elohim as the predicate is "አምላክ" (God, the true God), as the style guide has it; "እግዚአብሔር እግዚአብሔር ነው" would say nothing in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "हम उनके अपने हैं" (L), "हम उनके हैं" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The text is read "and his we are", as its notes direct, not as written, "and not we" (meaning m1), as the English does. Literal's "अपने" brings out that the people belong to God.

decisions.choice: velo 'anachnu read as 'and his we are' "わたしたちはその方のもの" (every level)
alternatives: わたしたち自身ではない
decisions.reason: The written text can be read 'and not we ourselves'; the reading tradition has 'and we are his' (m1, footnote), which the English follows, and so does the Japanese.

decisions.choice: de'u "知れ" (every level); tso'n mar'ito "その方の牧場の羊" (L), "その方が養われる群れ" (B), R explained, as 95:7
decisions.reason: Know is acknowledge, be sure (m2); the flock of his pasture is the people he shepherds (m3), in the words of 95:7.

source.text: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו׀בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ־ל֝֗וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise; give thanks to him, bless his name.

en.L: Enter {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} gates with thanksgiving, \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} courts with praise; \q give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: Come through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} gates giving thanks, \q into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} courtyards with praise; \q thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: Go through the gates of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple thanking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Go into its courtyards praising {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.

fr.L: Entrez par {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} portes avec l’action de grâce, \q dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} parvis avec la louange ; \q rendez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} grâce, bénissez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Franchissez {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} portes en rendant grâce, \q entrez dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} cours avec des louanges ; \q remerciez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} et bénissez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Passez les portes de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} remerciant. \q Entrez dans ses cours en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louant. \q Remerciez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} et louez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: Ingieni malango {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa shukrani, \q nyua {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa sifa; \q mshukuruni, libarikini jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Pitieni malango {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mkitoa shukrani, \q ingieni nyuani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} kwa sifa; \q mshukuruni na kulibariki jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Pitieni malango ya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} mkimshukuru. \q Ingieni katika viwanja vyake mkimsifu. \q Mshukuruni na kulisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Entren|Entrad}} por {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} puertas con acción de gracias, \q [por] {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} atrios con alabanza; \q {{plural_you:denle|dadle}} gracias, {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pasen|Pasad}} por {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} puertas dando gracias, \q a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} atrios con alabanza; \q {{plural_you:agradézcanle|agradecedle}} y {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: {{plural_you:Pasen|Pasad}} por las puertas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo dándole gracias. \q {{plural_you:Entren|Entrad}} en sus patios alabándolo. \q {{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} gracias y {{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

vi.L: Hãy vào các cổng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lời cảm tạ, \q [vào] các sân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lời ca ngợi; \q hãy cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy bước qua các cổng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà dâng lời cảm tạ, \q vào các sân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà ca ngợi; \q hãy cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy đi qua các cổng đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hãy vào sân đền thờ mà ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hãy cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 감사하며 그분의 문으로, \q 찬양하며 그분의 뜰로 들어가거라. \q 그분께 감사하고 그분의 이름을 송축하여라.
ko.B: 감사드리며 그분의 성문으로 들어가고, \q 찬양하며 그분의 뜰로 들어가거라. \q 그분께 감사드리고 그분의 이름을 송축하여라.
ko.R: 그분께 감사드리며 성전 문으로 들어가거라. \q 그분을 찬양하며 성전 뜰로 들어가거라. \q 그분께 감사드리고 그분의 이름을 찬양하여라.

pt.L: Entrem [pelas] {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} portas dando graças, \q [nos] {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} átrios com louvor; \q rendam graças a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, bendigam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.
pt.B: Passem pelas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} portas agradecendo, \q entrem nos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pátios com louvor; \q agradeçam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e bendigam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.
pt.R: Passem pelos portões do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo agradecendo a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Entrem nos pátios do templo louvando a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Agradeçam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e louvem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.

am.L: በምስጋና ወደ ደጆቹ፣ \q በውዳሴም ወደ አደባባዮቹ ግቡ፤ \q አመስግኑት፤ ስሙንም ባርኩ።
am.B: እያመሰገናችሁ በደጆቹ ግቡ፤ \q እያወደሳችሁም ወደ አደባባዮቹ ግቡ፤ \q አመስግኑት፤ ስሙንም ባርኩ።
am.R: እያመሰገናችሁት በቤተ መቅደሱ በሮች ግቡ። \q እያወደሳችሁት ወደ አደባባዮቹ ግቡ። \q አመስግኑት፤ ስሙንም አወድሱ።

hi.L: धन्यवाद करते हुए उनके द्वारों से प्रवेश करो, \q स्तुति करते हुए उनके आँगनों में; \q उनका धन्यवाद करो, उनके नाम को धन्य कहो।
hi.B: धन्यवाद देते हुए उनके द्वारों से भीतर आओ, \q स्तुति करते हुए उनके आँगनों में; \q उनका धन्यवाद करो और उनके नाम को धन्य कहो।
hi.R: उनके मंदिर के द्वारों से उनका धन्यवाद करते हुए जाओ। \q उसके आँगनों में उनकी स्तुति करते हुए जाओ। \q उनका धन्यवाद करो और उनके नाम की स्तुति करो।

ru.L: Войдите в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ворота с благодарением, \q в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} дворы — с хвалой; \q благодарите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, благословляйте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.B: Проходите через {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ворота, благодаря {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, \q входите в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} дворы с хвалой; \q благодарите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} и благословляйте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.R: Проходите через ворота {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} храма, благодаря {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. \q Входите во дворы храма, хваля {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. \q Благодарите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} и хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.

ja.L: 感謝をもって、その門に入れ。 \q 賛美をもって、その庭に[入れ]。 \q その方に感謝し、その名をほめたたえよ。
ja.B: 感謝をささげつつ、その門を通り、 \q 賛美しつつ、その庭に入れ。 \q その方に感謝し、その名をほめたたえよ。
ja.R: 感謝しながら、その方の神殿の門を通れ。 \q 賛美しながら、その庭に入れ。 \q その方に感謝し、その名をほめたたえよ。

decisions.choice: gates and courts: the way into the temple
decisions.reason: Worshipers went in through the temple gates into its open courts (24:7; 96:8).

decisions.choice: thanksgiving: thanks, perhaps a thank offering
decisions.reason: The word (todah) is the same as in the title (verse 1).

decisions.choice: of his temple
decisions.reason: Readable says whose gates these are.

decisions.choice: todah "感謝"; tehillah "賛美"; barekhu shemo "その名をほめたたえよ" (every level, the Psalter's barekh)
decisions.reason: Gates and courts are the way into the temple (m1), which R names; thanksgiving may be a thank offering too (m2), but the plain 感謝 keeps both.

source.text: כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד־דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For good [is] YHWH; forever [is] his loyal love, and to generation and generation his faithfulness.

en.L: For good [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; forever [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love, \q and to generation and generation {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love has no end, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness stands from one generation to the next.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is good! His faithful love lasts forever. \q He keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises to every generation, one after another.

fr.L: Car bon [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; pour toujours [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal, \q et de génération en génération {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon ; {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle n’a pas de fin, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité demeure d’une génération à l’autre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon ! Son amour fidèle dure toujours. \q Il tient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} promesses envers chaque génération, l’une après l’autre.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwema; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele, \q na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kizazi hata kizazi.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma hauna mwisho, \q na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unasimama tangu kizazi kimoja hadi kingine.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema! Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele. \q Anatimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa kila kizazi, kimoja baada ya kingine.

es.L: Porque bueno [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; para siempre [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal, \q y de generación en generación {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel no tiene fin, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad permanece de una generación a otra.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno! Su amor fiel dura para siempre. \q Él cumple {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas a cada generación, una tras otra.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] tốt lành; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] đến đời đời, \q và sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến đời này qua đời kia.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng tốt lành; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ dứt, \q và sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn mãi từ thế hệ này đến thế hệ kia.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật tốt lành! Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến mãi mãi. \q Ngài giữ lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với mọi thế hệ, hết thế hệ này đến thế hệ khác.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 선하시니, 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하고, \q 그분의 신실하심은 대대에 이른다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 선하시니, 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 끝이 없고, \q 그분의 신실하심은 대대로 이어진다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 선하시다! 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다. \q 그분께서는 대대로 모든 세대에게 약속을 지키신다.

pt.L: Porque bom [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; para sempre [é] o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal, \q e por geração e geração, a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fidelidade.
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é bom; o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal não tem fim, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fidelidade se mantém firme de uma geração à seguinte.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é bom! O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre. \q Ele cumpre as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} promessas a cada geração, uma depois da outra.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካም ነውና፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም [ነው]፤ \q ታማኝነቱም ለትውልድና ለትውልድ [ነው]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካም ነውና፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ፍጻሜ የለውም፤ \q ታማኝነቱም ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ይኖራል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካም ነው! ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ይኖራል። \q ለየትውልዱ ሁሉ የገባውን ተስፋ ይጠብቃል።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले [हैं]; उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है], \q और उनकी सच्चाई पीढ़ी और पीढ़ी तक [है]।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले हैं; उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है, \q और उनकी विश्वासयोग्यता एक पीढ़ी से दूसरी पीढ़ी तक बनी रहती है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले हैं! उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है। \q वे हर पीढ़ी के साथ, एक के बाद एक, अपने वादे निभाते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь благ {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}; вовек {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь, \q и из рода в род {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} верность.
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменной любви нет конца, \q и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} верность пребывает из поколения в поколение.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр! Его неизменная любовь длится вечно. \q Он исполняет свои обещания каждому поколению, одному за другим.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方。その誠実はとこしえに[続き]、 \q その真実は代々に[及ぶ]。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方、その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続き、 \q その真実は、世代から世代へと堅く立つ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方だ！その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。 \q その方は、どの時代の人々にも、次から次へと約束を守ってくださる。

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: the song of the temple: good, love forever
decisions.reason: "Good" and "his loyal love is forever" are the words of the temple's great song of thanks (106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; 2 Chronicles 5:13).

decisions.choice: faithfulness: firm reliability
decisions.reason: The word ('emunah) is steadiness, being someone others can rely on.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: keeps his promises
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's faithfulness does.

decisions.choice: bom [é] o SENHOR; para sempre [é] o seu amor leal (L); O seu amor leal dura para sempre (R)
decisions.reason: The words are those of the temple's song of thanks (m2), so Literal uses the wording of that refrain as 1 Chronicles 16:34 has it ("porque [ele é] bom, porque o seu amor leal [é] para sempre"), and Readable, where the English Readable has the refrain's "His faithful love lasts forever", keeps the refrain's "O seu amor leal dura para sempre" with "amor leal", as Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136 do.

decisions.choice: "good … his loyal love is forever" as the temple refrain ("መልካም ነውና", "ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም")
decisions.reason: The meaning decision ties these words to the temple song; they keep the wording of the refrain settled at Ezra 3:11 and 1 Chronicles 16:34, bent to this verse, where the Hebrew has no second "for".

decisions.choice: the refrain of 1 Chronicles 16:34
decisions.reason: "Good" and "his loyal love is forever" are the words of the temple's song of thanks (meaning m2), so each level keeps the Hindi of 1 Chronicles 16:34 ("भले [हैं]", "उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]" at Literal; "उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है" at Balanced and Readable), as the poetry note asks for the refrain. God's faithfulness is "सच्चाई" (L) and "विश्वासयोग्यता" (B); Readable says what it does, as its English does.

decisions.choice: "благ ... вовек неизменная любовь" (L); "добр" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of the temple song (m2) keep the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34 at each level where they are the same: "благ", "вовек ... неизменная любовь" (L), "добр" (B, R), "Его неизменная любовь длится вечно" (R).

decisions.choice: ki-tov YHWH le'olam chasdo "DNは良い方。その誠実はとこしえに[続き]" (L), "…その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続き" (B), "…いつまでも続く" (R), as the refrain of 1CH 16:34; 'emunato "その真実" (L, B), "約束を守ってくださる" (R)
decisions.reason: The temple refrain (m2) keeps the Psalter's wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34; chesed (m1) and 'emunah, firm reliability (m3), in their Psalter forms.
